title: Please provide Instructions for automated backup
symptom: The user asks for instructions on automated backup of xDrip data to avoid losing history if the phone is lost. They want to know if there is an easily accessible file that can be backed up automatically and transferred to another xDrip installation.
fix: The thread suggests using Nightscout as a backup solution, and mentions enabling 'Settings/Cloud Upload/Nightscout Sync/Download data' to pull data back, and 'Settings -> Less common settings -> Save Database Daily' for daily database saving, but notes that upload still needs to be automated.
settings_changed: Settings -> Less common settings -> Save Database Daily
evidence_quote: Settings -> Less common settings -> Save Database Daily
